mechanisms.quote: Migrated Live Photo pairing logic to DB write-time (denormalization) to enable O(1) streaming.
Refactored `AssetLoaderWorker` to use a generator and stream chunks progressively (first 20 items immediate).
This change eliminates the implicit B-Tree sort in SQLite, allowing O(1) latency for the first result row.
Removed synchronous `resolve()` calls in `AssetLoaderWorker` loop to eliminate I/O overhead.
Moved disk cache checking and loading from `ThumbnailLoader.request` (main thread) to `ThumbnailJob.run` (worker thread).
